You're absolutely right, my apologies. If the suite includes visual snapshot tests, then a CSS change is a very likely culprit. Snapshot tests compare rendered output against baseline images, so any CSS modifications will change the visual appearance and cause those comparisons to fail.

To diagnose:

1. Check the CI logs for which specific snapshot tests failed
2. Look at the visual diff if the CI platform shows it (most do)
3. Determine if your CSS changes are intentional and the snapshots need updating, or if it's an unintended side effect

If the changes are intentional, you'll need to update the baseline snapshots. If they're unintended, you may need to refine your CSS to avoid the visual regression.
